title: JEE Main 2026 (April 4th, Shift 1) - Mathematics - Sequences and Series
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: The first term of an A.P. of $30$ non-negative terms is $\frac{10}{3}$. If the sum of this A.P. is the cube of its last term, then its common difference is:
questions.explain:
Let the first term be $a = \frac{10}{3}$ and the last term be $l$.
The sum of the A.P. of $30$ terms is $S_{30} = \frac{30}{2}(a + l) = 15\left( \frac{10}{3} + l \right) = 50 + 15l$.
Given $S_{30} = l^3$, we have the equation $l^3 = 50 + 15l \implies l^3 - 15l - 50 = 0$.
Testing integer values, we find that for $l = 5$: $5^3 - 15(5) - 50 = 125 - 75 - 50 = 0$. So $l = 5$ is a root.
(The quadratic factor $l^2 + 5l + 10$ has no real roots, so $l = 5$ is the only real root).
The $30\text{th}$ term is $a + 29d = l$.
$\frac{10}{3} + 29d = 5 \implies 29d = 5 - \frac{10}{3} = \frac{5}{3} \implies d = \frac{5}{87}$.
